aggregation: Exactly 0.5 * EXAONE probability + 0.5 * rawMitra probability in float64; no fitted parameters.
alignment: Original random folds authenticated against saved v81 logs; original saved group folds and row arrays, never regenerate group partitions. Authenticate both complete EXAONE caches against committed source, resource, summary, protocol, fold logs and result hashes before averaging.
rationale: EXAONE has lower single-model random accuracy but lower random and group log loss than rawMitra. Test one fixed equal mean for complementary probabilities, after observing these single-model results.

continuation.meaning: Only eligibility for separate review of one mean export and upload; not a stable-superiority or significance claim.

stop_rules: Require this plan and implementation committed before any new mean score.
Both complete phases are required before publishing the random screen CSV for tiers; partial outputs are not a winner.
If either phase fails, archive this mean; do not search weights, thresholds, seeds, third components or subsets.
No automatic solo EXAONE fallback, no simultaneous solo/mean online comparison, no automatic export or upload.
Recheck current weekly reserve30 before execution; no overwrite or implicit resume.
disclosure: Adaptively selected using already observed single-model and earlier development results. Reused development random/group folds are not independent validation. No old holdout labels or external test answers are used.
